slides.title: I wrote a 'good enough' line for every room. My house got cleaner.
slides.sub: Perfect was the thing stopping me

slides.title: Kitchen: counters clear-ish
slides.body: Not empty. Clear enough to cook. That's the line.

slides.title: Bedroom: the bed is usable
slides.body: Clothes off the bed, path to the door. Done.

slides.title: Bathroom: wipe the sink
slides.body: Toothpaste gone, towel hung. The rest can wait for the weekly pass.

slides.title: Living room: nothing on the floor
slides.body: Blankets folded or tossed in a basket. Both count.

slides.title: Write it on a sticky note
slides.body: Put each line in its room. Our brains need to see the finish line.

slides.title: If I know what 'done' looks like, I can actually get there.
Want a 'done' line for every day?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
